items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Key CPI Focus
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Tuesday, Nov, 10 2026 US stocks are set for a cautiously positive open, with sentiment pinned almost entirely on the October CPI report. Futures pricing reflects a market leaning toward a gentle risk-on tone ahead of those inflation numbers. Economists expect headline CPI to rise 0.3% month on month, with core CPI at 0.2%. That combination would sit below September’s 0.6% headline reading and closer to the New York Fed’s 3.9% one year inflation...
